questions.q: What did Jim Rohn credit for turning his stuck situation around?
questions.why: The overview says he met his mentor after feeling stuck in a six-year job.

questions.q: How does lesson 1 say to build wealth through knowledge?
a: Practice self-led learning and reflect on experience daily
Take out loans for advanced degrees
Wait for a mentor to teach you
questions.why: Lesson 1 says you don't need huge loans and years of degrees; learn by yourself and reflect.

questions.q: What attitude toward taxes does Rohn recommend?
a: See the good they do and be positive about them
questions.why: Lesson 2 says a good attitude about taxes helps attract wealth.

questions.q: Which rule helps you keep your riches?
Why should you choose your associates carefully, per lesson 3?
a: The people you spend most time with shape who you become
questions.why: Lesson 3 says your closest people determine the kind of person you are.
